column1: # DATE rules (ADR-0008 §4.1, rules-date-v1). Format: see FactFixtures.kt.
# Weekdays used below (checked with Python's datetime, not the code under test):
# Numeric A/B/YYYY: two valid readings give candidates; one valid gives it; none abstains
# Two-digit years: both centuries plus year-first, never a single value
# A two-digit year never yields one definite date (review E-03)
# No year, year and month only, non-English names: abstained
# Ranges: recognised, abstained and claimed as a whole
# Token boundaries, continuation and non-ASCII digits (Z-16: no salvage)
# Claimed characters are not read again by a lower rule
# E-03: weekday filtering never makes a two-digit year definite
# E-05: '-' and a digit continue a numeric run
# E-06: format and combining marks attach
# E-08: Unicode space separators between parts
# E-09(c): three dotted groups stay date candidates (stated residual)
# Verification fixes 2026-11-26 (EE-04): a mark leading or inside a date abstains visibly
